applicability: The existing CMP0/CMP1 product R/S/P and ordinary typed-memory model; no new layout support, ghost state, or argument-buffer protocol permitted.
controls: Assess new minimal aggregate/move, ManuallyDrop, unsize/projection, ordinary argument, pointer parameter positives and three new ordinary argument negatives.
No local cargo/rustc/Kani/CBMC and no Cloud submission. Native acceptance remains NOT_RUN.
defect: CMP1 native positives fail with uninitialized usize reads in std IndexRange::len; padding-negative has required diagnostic absent. Assess only CMP2 minus CMP1 for soundness and applicable source checks. Do not treat the author implementation or diagnosis as established evidence.
invariants: Typed ordinary source reads remain checked before any parameter initialization can hide a false byte.
Empty MaybeUninit storage including nested product and ManuallyDrop S must retain every existing witness; pointer argument values must not initialize pointees.
R receives only the applicable typed ordinary mask after source checks, P=false; no blanket whole-product blessing.
Instrumentation source locations and ordering must remain valid at function entry, empty blocks, ordinary call/return and before/after reads/writes.
All35 negative CMP1 harness expectations are retained; changed padding fixtures still require the intended byte-level failures, not incidental pointer errors.
known_limitations: Only static validation authorized locally; exact failing-instance MIR/points-to binding unavailable in bounded CMP1 excerpts.
Build subset preserves all CMP1 selectors and adds2 selectors; review of new production is required before coordinator GO.
